I have launched the test using `defects4j test` to check the current test status and will wait for it to complete.
I have started running the test `org.mockitointegration.NoJUnitDependenciesTest::pure_mockito_should_not_depend_JUnit` to verify the fix.
I have started running `VerificationOverTimeImplTest` to ensure that existing verification tests continue to pass.
I have triggered `org.mockito.internal.verification.VerificationOverTimeImplTest::should_deal_with_junit_assertion_error` to ensure the behavior with JUnit assertion errors remains intact.
The bug has been resolved in accordance with the requirements.

### Cause of the Issue
[`VerificationOverTimeImpl`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/mockito_5_group_b_fix/src/org/mockito/internal/verification/VerificationOverTimeImpl.java) directly caught `org.mockito.exceptions.verification.junit.ArgumentsAreDifferent`, which subclasses JUnit's `ComparisonFailure`. This created a direct runtime dependency on JUnit in a core Mockito class, causing class loading failure (`NoClassDefFoundError`) in non-JUnit environments.

### Solution
In [`VerificationOverTimeImpl.java`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/mockito_5_group_b_fix/src/org/mockito/internal/verification/VerificationOverTimeImpl.java#L88-L94), the catch blocks for `MockitoAssertionError` and `org.mockito.exceptions.verification.junit.ArgumentsAreDifferent` were replaced with a single catch block for standard Java `AssertionError`. Both `MockitoAssertionError` and `ArgumentsAreDifferent` inherit from `java.lang.AssertionError`, enabling verification polling to work seamlessly without requiring JUnit on the classpath.

### Verification
- Ran `org.mockitointegration.NoJUnitDependenciesTest::pure_mockito_should_not_depend_JUnit`: Passed with 0 failures.
- Ran `org.mockito.internal.verification.VerificationOverTimeImplTest::should_deal_with_junit_assertion_error`: Passed with 0 failures.
- Generated the focused patch file [nl_fix.patch](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/mockito_5_group_b_fix/nl_fix.patch).
